summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the AI Horoscope (Gemini via Emergent LLM key) and the improved article sharing feature on Lux.Sex. All 5 pytest backend tests pass (daily reading returns full JSON reading + caches on 2nd call; invalid sign -> 400; personal SSE streams text deltas ending with done:true; missing name/birthdate -> 400). Frontend Playwright: age gate passed; clicking horoscope-sign-aries opens daily-reading-modal with loading state then daily-reading-content (913 chars); close button works. Personal Reading form streams into personal-reading-output (1473 chars) after filling name+birthdate. Home feed share menu opens with WhatsApp/Instagram/X/Facebook/Telegram/Copy link; WhatsApp href correctly contains the ARTICLE path (/turismo/hoteis/villamor-...), not just the home URL. Copy-link shows 'Link copied!' feedback. Article page share button also opens the menu. Home feed loads posts and language switcher present. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: PersonalReading.jsx: JSON.parse on SSE payloads has no try/catch; a malformed chunk aborts the whole stream. Consider wrapping in try/catch and skipping bad lines.
DailyReadingModal.jsx: on fetch error the modal shows an error message but has no retry button; user must close and reopen the sign card.
horoscope.py: personal endpoint uses raw user 'name' in session_id (LlmChat) — bounded to 80 chars, OK, but consider sanitizing to avoid weird session key characters.
horoscope.py: birthdate is accepted as free-form string with no format validation (min viable — LLM parses it) — consider Pydantic validator for ISO YYYY-MM-DD to fail fast.
seed_data_creation: Daily-horoscope cache doc(s) inserted in Mongo collection 'horoscopes' for signs aries+leao (date-scoped, will expire naturally next UTC day).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (AI horoscope + article sharing) are fully working end-to-end. Daily reading is cached per sign/date/lang in Mongo (horoscopes collection). Personal reading uses SSE (data: {t:...} chunks then data: {done:true}). Share targets in PostInteractions.jsx build URLs from postUrl prop; TimelinePostCard passes origin+articleHref, so home-feed cards correctly share the article's canonical URL. If retesting: use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, click 'Tenho 18+' age gate, testids: horoscope-sign-<slug>, daily-reading-modal/content/close-daily-reading, personal-name-input/personal-birthdate-input/personal-generate-btn/personal-reading-output, share-button/share-menu/share-whatsapp/share-instagram/share-copy-link.
